text:
incident-bot: 🚨 AUTOPAGE: High error rate detected for embeddings-queue-eu (eu-west-1). PagerDuty incident I-6239 created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/I-6239 — urgency: high.

mike: Acked. I'm on it — jumping into queue metrics + autoscaler.

aline: I can take a handoff if you need to dig into the background batch job. @mike do you want to pair or should I own?

mike: @aline please take ownership, heading to meetings. TL;DR: KV cache eviction spike + a backlog of scheduled embeddings. 5xx rate ~18% for last 3m.

aline: Taking ownership. First step: pause scheduled batch that started at 01:42UTC. Running quick rollback/kill.

sam: FYI customer signal — three PROD tenants report failed embeddings and timeouts: acme-inc, bluewave, syncly. CS already pinged them. Impact appears intermittent but users see degraded search.

aline: Confirmed a runaway batch job (user-import-worker) retry loop hitting the queue. Pausing it now:

```bash
kubectl -n jobs delete job user-import-worker-2026-03-17-0142
```

Applying soft throttle on embedding producer and nudging autoscaler: `scale deployment embed-worker-eu --replicas=20` -> bumping to 40.

pagerbot: Escalation check: original oncall did not respond within 6m before @mike acked; if ownership changes again, this will auto-escalate to oncall-2. No further action required.

jamie: oncall-2 here, joining the brief. Pulling logs + traces now. Let me know if you want me to open a bridge.

aline: Thanks @jamie — bridge not necessary yet. Initial metrics look good: 5xx down to 3% after pause + scale. Observability shows backlog draining. Monitoring for 10m.

sam: I'll update CS with interim note: "Throttled a runaway batch; embeddings queue recovered, customers should see normal behavior shortly."

mike: Thanks team — if levels hold for 10m, I'll close the incident. If we see reappearance, @aline please escalate to oncall-2 bridge.

aline: Acknowledged. Will ping here before any escalation. :white_check_mark:
